title: Existence of the factorized integral scalar morphism
statement: Fix the data of lem-sf-native-integral-scalar-morphism. For each finite coefficient index E, there exists a natural morphism tau between the two finite-stage compact-support functors after integral-to-rational localization, and for every finite-Tor integral input K its native-section component factors as b_K followed by PurCompactSupport.comparison(change E,c) and d_K, with b_K and d_K isomorphisms.

source.place: Definition 6.7.6, Proposition 6.8.14 and Remark 6.8.15; original finite-comparison steps 4 and 8

proof.text: The recorded rational compact-support action is the raw tensor extension of its integral action. Construct the natural isomorphism Q_X followed by the rational action to the integral action followed by Q_Y with identity object components. Naturality is the baseChange pure-tensor formula at 1 tensor h.

Use the stage-system inclusion comparison and StageAction.finite, followed by P.ring.rationalLeft, to identify the finite source with the recorded rational action. Compose the preceding localization isomorphism, the target integral realization, and inverse sfQcqsCompactSupportRealization. Transport the coefficient functor along ht E. This constructs a natural isomorphism b from the section realization of the integral finite-source functor to integral inclusion followed by completed compact support and native coefficient extension.

Transport coefficient extension along hs E, then compose the inverse source integral realization with inverse operationTransport. This constructs a natural isomorphism d from integral inclusion followed by native coefficient extension and native compact support to the section realization of the integral finite-target functor.

Whisker PurCompactSupport.comparison(change E,c) by the integral full-subcategory inclusion and sandwich it between b.hom and d.hom. The derived section functor is an equivalence, hence postcomposition by it is fully faithful. Lift this natural transformation uniquely through postcomposition. The map-preimage identity, evaluated at each finite-Tor integral input, gives the required factorization with b and d evaluated at that input.

proof_origin.place: Definition 6.7.6, Proposition 6.8.14 and Remark 6.8.15; explicit composition of the recorded localization, integral realization, proper/open scalar mate and section equivalence (K1).

theorem native_integral_scalar_morphism_exists [G : NativeGeometry.{u} l]
    (source : Realization l X) (target : Realization l Y)
    (stage : StageAction l D hl P c)
    (change : ∀ E : Index l (PadicAlgCl l),
      PurCompactSupport.Change (PurCompactSupport.completed l
        (Coefficient.{u} l (PadicAlgCl l) E)) (nativeCoefficients l))
    (hs : ∀ E, (change E).map X = (source.coefficient E).integralMap l X)
    (ht : ∀ E, (change E).map Y = (target.coefficient E).integralMap l Y)
    (E : Index l (PadicAlgCl l)) :
    ∃ tau : sfRationalConstructibleLocalization l
        (Coefficient l (PadicAlgCl l) E) X ⋙
        finiteSourceAux l D hl P c target stage E ⟶
      sfRationalConstructibleLocalization l
        (Coefficient l (PadicAlgCl l) E) X ⋙
        finiteTargetAux l c source E,
      ∀ K : finiteTorConstructibleIntegralCategory l
          (Coefficient l (PadicAlgCl l) E) X,
        ∃ (b : (sections l Y).mapDerivedCategory.obj
              ((sfRationalConstructibleLocalization l
                (Coefficient l (PadicAlgCl l) E) X ⋙
                finiteSourceAux l D hl P c target stage E).obj
                  ((PurCompactSupport.finiteTorIntegralInclusion l
                    (Coefficient l (PadicAlgCl l) E) X).obj K)) ≅
            (PurCompactSupport.image (PurCompactSupport.completed l
              (Coefficient l (PadicAlgCl l) E)) c ⋙
              pbcDerivedExtend ((change E).map Y)).obj K.obj)
          (d : (pbcDerivedExtend ((change E).map X) ⋙
              PurCompactSupport.image (nativeCoefficients l) c).obj K.obj ≅
            (sections l Y).mapDerivedCategory.obj
              ((sfRationalConstructibleLocalization l
                (Coefficient l (PadicAlgCl l) E) X ⋙
                finiteTargetAux l c source E).obj
                  ((PurCompactSupport.finiteTorIntegralInclusion l
                    (Coefficient l (PadicAlgCl l) E) X).obj K))),
          (sections l Y).mapDerivedCategory.map
              (tau.app ((PurCompactSupport.finiteTorIntegralInclusion l
                (Coefficient l (PadicAlgCl l) E) X).obj K)) =
            b.hom ≫ (PurCompactSupport.comparison (change E) c).app K.obj ≫ d.hom
